summary: Perfect Company, headquartered in Vancouver, WA and founded in 2013, makes KitchenPro, an automated kitchen-display and portion-control software/hardware system (including grill, fry, make, pack, drink, and drive-thru modules) plus a smart-scale ProMeasure product for accurate ingredient portioning.

Wingstop deployed a customized 'Wingstop Smart Kitchen' built on Perfect Company's KitchenPro Suite across all 2,500+ Wingstop locations — described as the brand's biggest technology deployment to date — reducing service time from 45+ minutes to 10 minutes, with a 16-point throughput gain during peak hours and a 17-point improvement in delivery customer satisfaction; Wingstop CEO Michael Skipworth called it 'a huge unlock' for expanding menu occasions. (Scope note: Performance statistics are from a vendor-published case study; independently audited operator-side confirmation of the exact figures was not found.)

Perfect Company has raised approximately $9M in total funding, with its most recent disclosed round ($6M) closing in January 2021; the company reports roughly $50M-$100M in estimated annual revenue and approximately 80 employees across 4 continents as of mid-2026. (Scope note: Revenue and employee-count figures come from a third-party data aggregator (LeadIQ), not a company-disclosed filing; treat as an estimate rather than confirmed financials.)
